Class GatingContext

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.core.GatingContext
public final class GatingContext extends Object
The context a SlotGate decision runs in — who/what is acting, plus the library-owned non-modded capability query. Absorbs Inventory Max's enforceForActingPlayer() pattern into the library so every gate gets the same primitive.

Acting player (the ThreadLocal)

A deep seam (a hopper transfer, vanilla's moveItemStackTo) has no player in scope. The library captures the acting player at the click boundary (setActingPlayer(Player)/clearActingPlayer(), always cleared in a finally) so a nested decision can see it. Automation (no player) and client-side prediction leave it null.

    • actingPlayerCapable

      public boolean actingPlayerCapable()
      Whether the acting player can see slot-state (i.e. is modded). A gate whose effect is invisible to a non-modded client (a shared lock) should bypass when this is false — they can't see it, so it shouldn't wall them (§0050). Returns true for automation / client-side / a capable server player (the safe-enforce direction); only a non-capable ServerPlayer is false.
